title: Pointwise local finite presentation descends along a field extension
statement: Let k be a field, K/k a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], f:X\to Y a morphism of k-schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-morphism-conventions], x\in X, and x_K\in X_K a point above x [def-pc-base-change]. If the base-change morphism f_K:X_K\to Y_K is locally of finite presentation on an open neighbourhood of x_K [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], then f is locally of finite presentation on an open neighbourhood of x.

source.place: pointwise descent along a field extension, obtained from Varieties Lemma 33.9 (Tag 0C4Y) and the affine-local definition of locally of finite presentation; no single Stacks tag states this pointwise formulation

proof.text: Choose an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq Y$ containing $f(x)$ and an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}B\subseteq f^{-1}(\operatorname{Spec}A)$ containing $x$, and let $\mathfrak q\subset B$ be the prime of $x$. Then $\operatorname{Spec}(B\otimes_kK)\subseteq X_K$ is the preimage of $\operatorname{Spec}B$, it maps into $\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_kK)$ under $f_K$, and $x_K$ is a prime $\mathfrak q_K\subset B\otimes_kK$ with $\mathfrak q_K\cap B=\mathfrak q$. Since $f_K$ is locally of finite presentation on an open $W\ni x_K$ [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], choose $u\in B\otimes_kK$, $u\notin\mathfrak q_K$, with $D(u)\subseteq W$; then $D(u)=\operatorname{Spec}((B\otimes_kK)_u)$ is an affine open on which $f_K$ is locally of finite presentation, so $(B\otimes_kK)_u$ is a finitely presented $A\otimes_kK$-algebra [lem-weil-pbc-lfp-affine-opens-finite-presentation]. The same holds for $u(c\otimes1)$ in place of $u$ for any $c\in B\setminus\mathfrak q$, since $D(u(c\otimes1))\subseteq D(u)$.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 33.9 (Tag 0C4Y): flat local maps of local rings along a field extension; combined with the affine-local definition of locally of finite presentation

proof.text: Auxiliary claim. Let $C$ be a $k$-algebra, $\varphi:M\to N$ a homomorphism of $C$-modules, $v\in C\otimes_kK$ and $P\in D(v)\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}(C\otimes_kK)$ with $\mathfrak p=P\cap C$. If $(\varphi\otimes K)_v:(M\otimes_kK)_v\to(N\otimes_kK)_v$ is surjective, then there is $c\in C\setminus\mathfrak p$ with $\varphi_c:M_c\to N_c$ surjective. Proof: the projection $\pi:\operatorname{Spec}(C\otimes_kK)=\operatorname{Spec}K\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}C$ is open [lem-sc-scheme-over-field-universally-open], so $\pi(D(v))$ is an open set containing $\mathfrak p$; choose $c\notin\mathfrak p$ with $D(c)\subseteq\pi(D(v))$. For $\mathfrak p'\in D(c)$ pick $P'\in D(v)$ over it. The map $C\to C\otimes_kK$ is flat [lem-weil-pbc-field-extension-base-change-faithfully-flat], so $C_{\mathfrak p'}\to(C\otimes_kK)_{P'}$ is a flat local homomorphism, and $\varphi_{\mathfrak p'}\otimes_{C_{\mathfrak p'}}(C\otimes_kK)_{P'}$ is the localization of $(\varphi\otimes K)_v$ at $P'$, hence surjective; therefore $\varphi_{\mathfrak p'}$ is surjective [lem-pc-local-flat-faithful-flat-reflects-surjective]. Surjectivity at every prime of $C_c$ gives $\varphi_c$ surjective.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 33.9 (Tag 0C4Y): flat local maps of local rings along a field extension; combined with the affine-local definition of locally of finite presentation

proof.text: Finite type near $x$. Write $u=\sum_i b_i\otimes\lambda_i$, and choose generators $y_j/u^{n}$ of the finitely generated $A\otimes_kK$-algebra $(B\otimes_kK)_u$ (Step 1) with $y_j=\sum_l b_{jl}\otimes\mu_{jl}$. Let $B'\subseteq B$ be the $A$-subalgebra generated by all $b_i,b_{jl}$. As $K$ is flat over $k$ [lem-weil-pbc-field-extension-base-change-faithfully-flat], $B'\otimes_kK\subseteq B\otimes_kK$, $u\in B'\otimes_kK$, and $(B'\otimes_kK)_u\to(B\otimes_kK)_u$ is surjective. Step 2 with $C=B'$, $\varphi$ the inclusion $B'\to B$, $v=u$ and $P=\mathfrak q_K\cap(B'\otimes_kK)$ gives $c\in B'\setminus\mathfrak q$ with $B'_c\to B_c$ surjective, so $B_c$ is a finitely generated $A$-algebra. Replace $B$ by $B_c$ and $u$ by $u(c\otimes1)$; Step 1 still applies.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 33.9 (Tag 0C4Y): flat local maps of local rings along a field extension; combined with the affine-local definition of locally of finite presentation

proof.text: Finite presentation near $x$. Choose a surjection $\alpha:A[x_1,\dots,x_n]\to B$ of $A$-algebras with kernel $I$, and a lift $\tilde u\in A[x_1,\dots,x_n]\otimes_kK$ of $u$. By flatness of $K$ over $k$ [lem-weil-pbc-field-extension-base-change-faithfully-flat], $\alpha\otimes K$ is surjective with kernel $I\otimes_kK$, so $(A\otimes_kK)[x_1,\dots,x_n,y]\to(B\otimes_kK)_u$, $y\mapsto1/u$, is surjective with kernel $(I\otimes_kK)+(\tilde uy-1)$. This kernel is finitely generated [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-surjection-kernel-fg], so it is generated by $\tilde uy-1$ and finitely many elements of $I\otimes_kK$, which involve finitely many elements of $I$; let $J\subseteq I$ be the ideal they generate. Then $(J\otimes_kK)_{\tilde u}\to(I\otimes_kK)_{\tilde u}$ is surjective, and Step 2 with $C=A[x_1,\dots,x_n]$, $\varphi$ the inclusion $J\to I$, $v=\tilde u$ and $P$ the preimage of $\mathfrak q_K$ gives $c'\notin\alpha^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$ with $J_{c'}=I_{c'}$. With $s=\alpha(c')\notin\mathfrak q$ we get $B_s\cong A[x_1,\dots,x_n,y]/(J+(c'y-1))$, a quotient by a finitely generated ideal, so $A\to B_s$ is of finite presentation.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 33.9 (Tag 0C4Y): flat local maps of local rings along a field extension; combined with the affine-local definition of locally of finite presentation

proof.text: The principal open $D(s)=\operatorname{Spec}B_s\subseteq X$ is an affine open neighbourhood of $x$ mapping into $\operatorname{Spec}A$, and $A\to B_s$ is of finite presentation (Step 4). By the definition [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], $f$ is of finite presentation at every point of $D(s)$, i.e. locally of finite presentation on the open neighbourhood $D(s)$ of $x$.

lean.statement: theorem locallyOfFinitePresentation_near_of_fieldExtension (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] (X Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X.left) : let i := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) ∀ (xK : ↥(pullback X.hom i)), pullback.fst X.hom i xK = x → (∃ W : (pullback X.hom i).Opens, xK ∈ W ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation (W.ι ≫ ((Over.pullback i).map f).left)) → ∃ U : X.left.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation (U.ι ≫ f.left)

reviewed_lean.note: k,K fields with Algebra k K; X,Y,f k-schemes/morphism as Over (Spec k) objects and hom; X_K = pullback X.hom i with i = Spec.map algebraMap; f_K = ((Over.pullback i).map f).left (recorded h_T of def-pc-base-change); xK above x via pullback.fst; hypothesis exists open W ∋ xK with W.ι ≫ f_K LocallyOfFinitePresentation; conclusion exists open U ∋ x with U.ι ≫ f.left LocallyOfFinitePresentation; #check confirms CategoryTheory.Over.pullback and AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFinitePresentation
